commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "f4afaff647ad5ceaf55d21e8f17a2ee06042b2c7"
cd frontend
npm ci >/tmp/photomap-npm-ci.log 2>&1
echo '=== package.json ==='
cat package.json
echo '=== npm audit ==='
npm audit --json || true
echo '=== npm outdated ==='
npm outdated || true
cd ..
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
